office_does: The sheriff runs the Franklin County Sheriff's Office, the county's chief law-enforcement agency, which patrols the unincorporated county, makes arrests and serves court orders and warrants.
race_blurb: Open seat after Sheriff J.D. Raymond's retirement. Undersheriff Monty Huber (47.8% in the primary) runs on continuity and a behavioral health recovery center; Connell Police Chief Chris Lee (30.6%) runs on law and order, fiscal discipline and refocusing the office. Both prefer the Republican Party.

candidates.summary: Franklin County undersheriff with 23-plus years in the office, a 12-year Army Ranger veteran and former Connell council member.
highlights: Second in command; former SWAT, investigations and training commander [S1]
Helped lead the office to full accreditation and set up continuous deputy training [S1]
Would spend political capital funding the Behavioral Health Recovery Center as an alternative to jail or the ER [S3]
Endorsed by the sheriff's command staff guild, a retired sheriff and several Washington sheriffs [S2]

experience.basis: Career inside the office he seeks to lead, now undersheriff, running explicitly on experience and continuity.

safety.basis: Enforcement career and proactive-patrol platform, tempered by his signature push for a behavioral health center as an alternative to jail.

candidates.summary: Connell police chief and Marine Corps veteran with 25-plus years in several Tri-Cities agencies, running from outside the sheriff's office.
highlights: Connell police chief; earlier Pasco and Richland police and Hanford Patrol; FBI National Academy graduate [S1]
Promises to enforce the law, defend victims and 'keep dangerous criminals off our streets' [S1]
Wants the office 'realigned' with its mission in his first year [S2]

experience.basis: Senior police executive, but has never served in the sheriff's office and runs on refocusing it.

safety.basis: Statement centers on law and order: enforce the law, back deputies, defend victims and keep dangerous criminals off the streets.

spending.basis: Says taxpayers deserve accountability and government should operate with fiscal discipline.
